## Coming soon

This dashboard will allow you to track event trends over time, detect
anomalies, and compare patterns across different event sources.

## Planned features

- Configurable time windows (hourly, daily, weekly)
- Anomaly detection with adjustable sensitivity
- Comparison mode for multiple event types
- Export to CSV and PNG
